editorial:
Imagine starting a new job at a pet store only to find out your coworkers are totally out to get you. That is exactly what happens in this funny flick. You follow the new guy who just wants to make some money, but two salty veteran salesmen are doing everything they can to ruin his sales. It feels like a classic office battle, but with fish tanks and dog food. The vibe is light and silly, making it the perfect choice for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want to laugh at some workplace drama.

The acting is surprisingly great, and the way the pranks escalate keeps you glued to your seat. While some of the jokes feel a bit dated since it came out in 1999, the pacing is snappy and never gets boring. If you love underdog stories where the little guy wins, you will have a blast. You can currently stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp picture, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a great move for the best quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, the new hire sets a clever trap using the store's inventory to expose the veterans. He catches them in the act of sabotaging a huge sale right in front of the manager. The two bullies get fired on the spot, and the protagonist gets promoted to lead salesman. It wraps up with a funny scene where he finally gets some peace and quiet in the store, proving that being the nice guy pays off.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves workplace comedies and underdog stories.
